title: New Music: Uncle Murda -Rap Up 2017
htmlContent:
[caption id="attachment_98672" align="aligncenter" width="235"] Photo credit - Uncle Murda[/caption]   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tLt01ZM7Syk&list=RDtLt01ZM7Syk&t=11   Uncle Murda finished  2017 on a high note with the of Don’t Come Outside- Volume 1, but before he ultimately turned the page on 2017, in what has now become tradition, he puts a bow along the year in hip-hop with his 9-minute recap. “This yearly rap up is gonna make people that I already don't like mad at me, and I’m not holding back any punches.  It's also gonna make you laugh, cause I mentioned all the clown shit people did this year; I don't mind throwing them under the bus or hurting they feelings because I'm not friends with them anyway.”
